title: Monotonization reduces coalitional influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$, and let $J$ be a set of coordinates. The coalitional influence of the coordinatewise monotonization of $f$ on $J$ is at most the coalitional influence of $f$ on $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates
